args.prompt: Continue the same storm and the same three-masted pirate ship with uninterrupted forward camera motion. The camera is now closer to the vessel, moving through heavy rain, fog and violent sea spray while the ship rolls and climbs over black waves. Rigging, sails, foam, mist and rain all move naturally. Lightning must read as short, violent flashes separated by deep storm darkness, with illumination jumping to another part of the clouds and reflecting briefly across the wet hull and wave crests. Preserve realistic scale, coherent ship geometry, cinematic photorealism and continuous motion; no cut.
args.negative_prompt: static image, frozen sea, frozen rain, stationary ship, permanent lightning, continuous glowing bolt, calm ocean, daylight, cartoon, illustration, text, watermark, duplicate ship, malformed sails, warped hull, camera teleport, sudden cut
